reproduction.description: Exposes the tridiagonal Hessian, compares two real derivative strategies and checks the original five-dimensional stationary candidate.
differences: Independent TypeScript conceptual reproduction; not execution or validation of the original MATLAB/Octave program.
12 rather than 20 dimensions, at most 130 updates; two Hessian strategies instead of all four fminunc options.
No sparse solver benchmark or wall-clock claims; objective/gradient evaluation counts are reported. Nonglobal stationary points are labeled.
